name: crm_shell
description: The authenticated CRM app frame: a left rail of sections (Dashboard, My work, Pipeline, Accounts, Contacts, Leads) + a slim topbar carrying the page title and an optional primary action, with the page body rendered in the `body` slot. All colours are --brand-* from app.json, so theme + branding are inherited rather than hard-coded. Pass `active` to highlight the current section.

active.description: Which left-rail section to highlight: one of `dashboard`, `work`, `pipeline`, `accounts`, `contacts`, `leads`.

title.description: Page title shown in the topbar.

action_href.description: When set, renders a primary action button in the topbar linking here (e.g. `/app/contacts/new`).

action_label.description: Label for the topbar primary action button. Ignored when `action_href` is empty.

body.description: The page body, rendered to the right of the rail / below the topbar. Required.
